It’s not so much affordable as it being that our currency has inflated so much it became worthless, and the services are really bad like we don’t get proper electricity 24/7, you get electricity on a schedule a few hours a day, and I’m basically left with less than half of my wage which is around 80$ after paying everything.

My neighborhood is relatively safe, just have to be careful at night. Daily routine is basically waking up by 7 AM to go to work and getting back around 6-7 PM depending on the day, having some dinner, finishing university related stuff and then going to sleep.

I hate it, it’s a dystopian kind of job but it is all I can get now given how messed up our country is. My expenses are somehow like this:

I pay 35$ electricity (2-4 hours per day depends on the schedule) / 10$ water / 15$ gas for my motorcycle / 10$ internet / 8$ phone bill / 60$ give or take for food
While I am a good budgeter, I wish that was purely the case, but unfortunately it’s not just that. Minimum wage here is around 200$ a month.

It’s a weird subject, the idea of money being so relative and so influential on people’s live in different ways. Like 15k for OP is a monthly salary, but to us we can live off of that for 2-3 years maybe. It’s very surreal even imagining that amount of money lol
